experiments.note: Support connects selected functions under test host orchestration; it does not execute Network::train, CUDA launches, Thrust or cuBLAS. Every intermediate activation/probability/delta and every gradient, weight, bias, moment, velocity and consumed accumulator is checked. Active sets are sparse; both absent-label insertion and existing-label count promotion are checked. A connected Adam near-tie rank swap changes three WTA addresses; rebuilt bucket membership and query lengths differ from the saved stale index. Historical natural-log WTA packing is retained. Per-step hidden-delta reset is an explicit test substitution: source review found constructor-only initialization and the companion stale-state test characterizes reuse. GPU reductions, races, scheduling, production reset wiring, native teardown and convergence remain pending.

experiments.note: This entry records an observed state-lifetime gap and is not evidence of paper-required accumulation or a production fix. The two-step fixture observes stale-delta discrepancy 0.201329470 and independently verifies that it equals the retained prior buffer. The main composition resets hidden deltas explicitly on the host. A focused production follow-up must confirm native behavior and choose/reset the intended per-step lifetime.
